subject: general
question: Select the correct IUPAC names for CH₃COCH₃ and C₂H₅OH compounds, respectively.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Propanone and ethanol**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Propanone** is the IUPAC name for the compound with the formula **CH3COCH3**. It is commonly known as **acetone**.
 
• Propanone is the **simplest ketone** and has various applications, including its use as a solvent in the laboratory and in the industry.
 
• **Ethanol** is the IUPAC name for **C2H5OH**. It is also known as **ethyl alcohol**.
 
• Ethanol is widely used as a solvent, in alcoholic beverages, and as a fuel or fuel additive.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Propanone and methanol**__

 __
 
• **Methanol** is the simplest alcohol with the formula **CH3OH**. It is also known as **methyl alcohol**.
 
• Methanol is used as a solvent, antifreeze, fuel, and as a denaturant for ethanol.
 
 
 
• **Propanoic acid and ethanol**__
 __
 
• **Propanoic acid** is a **carboxylic acid** with the formula **CH3CH2COOH**. It is used as a preservative and in the production of herbicides.
 
 
 
• **Ethanol and propanone**__
 
 
• This option is incorrect because the order of the compounds is reversed. The question asked for the IUPAC names of **CH3COCH3** first and then **C2H5OH**.
